title: Maple Marble Run
prompt: A wooden marble run with spiral ramps and a lift: a glass marble rolls down the curving tracks, drops through a funnel and is lifted back to the top as a seamless loop.
description: Build a two-rail helix with a turned wooden funnel and synchronize a glass marble, return lift and follow camera.
